Name: Draco Jaw
Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict Burn (1) on the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict Frostbite (1) on the Target.
Description: The User bites into the Target with its ancient draconic energy. The primordial forces of fire, ice and electricity permeates the attack.
